The plan lists the family rack-box-v3b; no meter window, front vent block or handles are modelled because no page read states them, so the rack-box v2 params are used. 483 x 311 x 89 mm (dealer, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
